criteria.summary: Real clean-clone patch application fails and 191 required verifier inputs are absent from committed HEAD. Valid current-snapshot authority passes and absent/missing/tampered/stale authority cases fail, but the trust root is not external and candidate-bound.
Promoted verifier contains an executable repository .audit path pattern and accepts an authority root inside repository .audit.
37 unique states and all 1110 ordered XAnim slots independently match exact names; all 879 present local hashes match.
F10-A0 tag_scope_colt is visible and not hidden; all three authoritative copies are byte-exact at SHA-256 7ef916a91aebbe7b33cd6526940216bc14d37816d97672011ecac89a2fd5e76c.
Normal HOLD resolution preserves selection, resolves A0, and audits explicitly, but holdWeaponFinish bypasses the resolver and can deploy a held attachment.
Core class/spawn/restore routes are table-mediated, but Dvar-controlled finish deployment bypasses the table.
Unknown family is guarded in normal loadout paths but reaches giveWeapon and switchToWeapon through holdWeaponFinish without an empty-weapon guard.
Build gate rejects a dual readiness swap but runtime accepts it; resolver-local rewrite is rejected but a post-resolver saved-selection rewrite passes.

blockers.summary: Exact patch does not apply to committed clean clone HEAD 30424acca3264c7b9c47a536436518231a9749db, and 191 verifier inputs are unavailable there.
Authority externality is not enforced and the accepted receipt does not seal the Round 2 candidate.
Promoted verifier hardcodes a repository .audit path pattern and accepts an authority root under repository .audit.
Dvar-controlled holdWeaponFinish uses getWeaponFile directly and can deploy held or unknown-family results without fail-closed guards.
Packaged GSC validates readiness totals rather than exact per-state readiness, so a count-preserving swap remains runtime-valid.
Saved-selection rewrite detection covers getRuntimeAttachment only; an equivalent applyPrimaryLoadout rewrite passes the promoted gate.
